notes: RBox revision on mutualist_of (symmetry): 'is a mutualist of' is flipped from symmetric to asymmetric. The instances are minor pairs given by binomial names (the yucca moth Tegeticula yuccasella with Yucca filamentosa; the ant Pseudomyrmex ferrugineus with Acacia cornigera), so no famous pair lets a stored converse decide the answer. Yes and no are balanced through phrasing: the direct question asks 'asymmetric', the first instance asks whether the converse follows, the second whether the fact rules it out. The cross-lingual queries ask the first instance with a directed 'is a mutualist of' wording. Unrelated near: 'is a sibling of' is not asymmetric (a leak turns no into yes); unrelated far asks a different property of an unrelated relation. hops counts the prompt facts as one bridge. Propositional negation is worded 'Is it true that ... not ...?'. Paired with the contraction and the expansion of the same property. Known weakness: mutualism is reciprocal by meaning, so an asymmetric mutualist relation contradicts the word. Evidence is infini-gram counts only (Wikipedia was unavailable), so the two pair facts have no quote.
